purpose: Within-state target-bundle objective geometry on ingested TRAIN support, not applied optimizer geometry or playing strength.
author_review_limit: Original author proposed the direction. Scientific component and concrete corrected implementation separately independently accepted; this root freeze remains non-executing until fresh resource admission.

sampling.bank: TRAIN only; all retained qualified NET rows eligible, no ply filter
sampling.rule: Per game min (SHA256(UTF8(salt+physical_row_id)), numeric retained-row ordinal). ALL retained rows; no ply or outcome filter.
sampling.unit: One equal-weight game/root; TRAIN-ingested, not held out or unseen.

descriptive_game_tags.primary: All32 together; tags are descriptive, not exclusion or separate selection gates.

states.other_states: Descriptive fixed context, no best-state selection
states.identities: These immutable three model paths/SHA and accepted custody bind this candidate; verify before and after measurement, no new checkpoint choices.

context.augmentation: No mirror, feature dropout or row augmentation
context.numerics: Fixed qualified E2TB math/AMP context; capture realized dtype/device/TF32/thread settings. No optimizer, scheduler, clip, compile or parameter update.
context.interpretation: Unaugmented loss geometry, not the realized training gradient sequence.

six_gradient_families.P: Actual source-weighted policy_ce + soft_policy_ce + future_policy_ce; common to both arms.
six_gradient_families.U: Every other active source-weighted common term from captured weighted_terms, excluding P/W/C; current realized nonzero terms are volatility and moves_left. Do not assume missing/zero eligibility means perfect supervision.
six_gradient_families.W_A: Actual source w_wdl * blended_wdl_ce with FULLA main value target.
six_gradient_families.C_A: Actual source w_categorical * categorical_ce with FULLA categorical target.
six_gradient_families.W_B: Actual source w_wdl * blended_wdl_ce with FULLB main value target.
six_gradient_families.C_B: Actual source w_categorical * categorical_ce with FULLB categorical target.

objective_integrity.targets: Unchanged qualified TRAIN raw/stored/proof loader and exact two existing FULLA/FULLB target maps, no new coefficients or relabels. Preserve complete175-plane history and legal masks.
objective_integrity.graph: Do not detach shared/coupled heads. Same-state/root forward shared between target maps where actual graph permits.
objective_integrity.sum_control: On EVERY row and both target maps, capture actual active weighted_terms and fold LEFT in actual source declaration order, skipping exactly zero weights, to reproduce actual source total BITEXACT. Preserve differentiable means/masks. Grouped-family scalar residuals are reported separately; their different summation order is not a scalar source-fold failure.
objective_integrity.masks_denominators: Record actual per-term eligibility/presence masks, mask numerator, source denominator and whether zero/clamped; preserve source masked_mean sum(mask).clamp_min(1) where used. A masked-zero loss is unavailable supervision, not perfect fit. No per-term renormalization/replacement or masking roots out of the primary.
objective_integrity.fallback_trace: For both target maps record actual search/SF field presence, claimed masks, finite checks, effective availability, realized search/SF/outcome target mass including fallback/terminal transfer; record categorical raw/stored/host target signatures and realized rebuild flags. Coverage fractions are not recipe shares. Existing loss fallback stays unchanged; expose it rather than silently call all rows search-supervised.
objective_integrity.gradient_reconstruction_control: On the first fixed root at EACH state, differentiate actual combined source total for A and B (+6 gradient calls). Report full-trunk residual vs separately differentiated family sum. BF16 cotangent rounding makes this residual diagnostic, NOT a bitmatch/threshold acceptance gate. Primary explicitly uses SUM of separately measured W+C gradients, not the gradient of a combined optimizer objective.
objective_integrity.capture_api: Accepted source-v2 current-thread sys.setprofile return capture of actual compute_loss weighted_terms and masks/fallback locals, restored in finally; actual-source synthetic CPU controls passed. Real-model BF16 controls remain part of the one fixed GPU stage.

gradient_scope.primary: All shared-trunk deduplicated physical parameters from actual source role/alias map, identical ordered membership across three states.
gradient_scope.coverage: Retain parameter names/roles/routes/aliases/numel, zero versus None gradients, shared-trunk/layer/optimizer-route norm-square and dot sufficient statistics. No selected-eight substitute.
gradient_scope.other_families: Report P vs W, C, W+C and U separately plus W/C norm ratios, all descriptive beyond primary.
gradient_scope.physical_scope_binding: Match exact ordered names/aliases/shapes/dtypes/routes against accepted actual map; dedup shared physical tensors once, including tied1,048,576-element Smolgen generator with16aliases.
gradient_scope.phase_output_adapter: Must be False and absent, assert before measurement. A present upstream adapter is unsupported by this fixed map, not silently excluded.
gradient_scope.coupling_precision: Categorical follows value_wdl.hidden including token_proj/net.0; net.2 is WDL-only projection, so categorical None there is expected. Policy-specific/output-head parameters are outside shared-trunk primary.

primary.per_game: d = cos(g_P,g_W_B+g_C_B) - cos(g_P,g_W_A+g_C_A), at DONOR only.
primary.summary: In canonical fixed numeric game order form32paired d values at DONOR; NumPy default_rng(2026111501) draws10000x32 game indices with replacement ONCE; compute paired d means and percentile[2.5,97.5] interval, equal-game weights. Never bootstrap arms separately.
primary.undefined: Any norm<=1e-12, nonfinite or missing primary denominator => primary INCONCLUSIVE, all32 retained in readout, no epsilon-created cosine or silent dropping.
primary.readout: An interval excluding0 supports a bundle-related geometry difference on these sampled TRAIN roots. Its sign is not improvement; containing0 is unresolved, not equivalence/no effect. No strength/adoption/recipe-selection endpoint.
primary.resolution_limit: The prospectively chosen1e-5 sentinel drift rule is measurement resolution, not a proven global backend error bound. Primary inference is conditional on it; opening-family dependence/single cohort limit bootstrap inference.

controls.sentinel: Repeat the first fixed roster root once at EACH state (same fixed inputs/targets/context; no extra forward beyond99).

cosine_and_drift.scope: Both primary cosines and their d, sentinel at each state; norm<=1e-12 remains undefined.

controls.interpretation: Chosen prospective resolution, not evidence all backend/root gradients obey this bound. No threshold retuning after measurement.
controls.gradient_reconstruction: Source-total A/B sentinel gradients add6calls; separately summed BF16-family reconstruction residuals REPORTED, not a bitmatch or acceptance threshold.
controls.descriptive_unavailable: Zero/None U or unused head gradients reported as coverage, not automatic primary failure if primary remains defined.
controls.failure: Any required schema/proof/identity/finite/map/source-scalar/repeat failure => numerical/technical INCONCLUSIVE, retain partials, no new roots/retry/extension/alternate recipe.

budget.model_residency: One state at a time; an empty nonstepping Trainer/optimizer OBJECT for actual preparation/map is permitted. No loaded optimizer state, optimizer.step, scheduler advance, saved checkpoint or parameter update.
budget.execution: No execution admitted; concrete independently reviewed helper/identities/command and root admission required.

limits: Raw Euclidean gradient cosines do not measure Aurora/AdamW applied updates; momentum/preconditioning and AuxAdamW-only clipping matter.
No causal strength/optimal clipping/dose/SF-anchoring conclusion; no400-update extension or second RNG realization selected.
Uniform learner sampling does not undo producer disagreement-based retention; results describe retained TRAIN support only.
Existing P1 SF value/opponent-reply policy are not a newly qualified P0 ruler; no teacher queries or teacher-identity/parity claims.
No HOLD, old playing-panel reuse, seven-model rerun, new candidate, or automatic follow-up.
Natural15/TB17 tags are descriptive only, all32 are primary. No seven-model rerun; only fixed DONOR/A40/B40.

The game bootstrap is conditional on this retained TRAIN cohort and fixed root sample; shared opening-family correlation is not separately corrected and no unseen-data or population-generalization claim follows.

fresh_state_control.optimizer: Object may exist; actual state/moments empty, step0, no advance.
fresh_state_control.parameters: Model bytes must equal selected immutable state before/after, all494 model entries finite; no parameter mutation.
fresh_state_control.cleanup: Remove hooks/profile and strong references, close loaders, release prior model before nextstate; record owner closure and peak resources.

readout_branches.complete_informative: All32 primary defined, required controls qualified; report interval/geometry only. Excluding0 = conditional target-bundle geometry difference, not better strength or optimizer effect.
readout_branches.complete_unresolved: Primary interval includes0 => unresolved, not equivalence/no effect; donor remains retained.
readout_branches.partial_startup_failure: Preserve partial identities/counters/error/resource closure, no primary inference/retry/extension.
readout_branches.numerical_failure: Preserve repeat/reconstruction/mask/fallback evidence; numerical-unqualified INCONCLUSIVE, no resolution retuning.
readout_branches.all_branches: No adoption, new candidate, reopened E2 panels, teacher query, second40-update replicate, dose extension, or next-study execution automatically selected.
